text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was at the intensive training 
camp on Tracen Island with Ines Fuujin, I 
went out scouting after practice without 
telling her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't you let your hair down here?
It's 
quiet, and there's no one around.
choice_data_list: Thank you, that really helped!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not really...
Only because you said it was 
for Ines-senpai.
I thought she was pushing 
herself too hard, too.
choice_data_list: Thanks, that really saved me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Give her some TLC on her day off 
tomorrow. Bring her here as a surprise."
choice_data_list: Yeah! Time to refresh yourself to ...
Yeah! I'm gonna make sure you get ...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! I have my part-time job 
now!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll have you refresh to you...
Yeah! We're gonna get you totally ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I asked her if she'd like to hang 
out, only to freeze at her unexpected 
response...
choice_data_list: Wait, what?! A part-time job on a ...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I applied for a part-time job surveying 
the island's ecosystem. It might take the 
whole day, so I probably won't have time 
to hang out...
choice_data_list: I'll help you with that investigation!
I'll help you with that investigation!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You too?
choice_data_list: I'll help with that investigation too!
'll help with that investigation, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Jeez, your eyes are all 
sparkly. Do you really want to play with 
big sis Ines that badly~?
choice_data_list: If we finish early, that leaves us...
If we finish early, that gives us ...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, since you offered, maybe 
I'll take you up on that♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Apparently the trees around here are full 
of all kinds of bugs! They said they want 
photos of what species are out here.
choice_data_list: Then I'll borrow that camera, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle!!)
choice_data_list: Then I'm borrowing that camera!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nyah!? Trainer, you're at the top 
already!?
choice_data_list: —Shoot's done! Next!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Next is mushroom gathering. I hear they 
grow beyond those rocks, though...
choice_data_list: ――Photo complete! Next!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eee!? Hopping from rock to rock like a 
ninja!
choice_data_list: I'll take a shortcut and go gather...
I'll take a shortcut and go pick some!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I will do everything I can to guide you 
to a relaxing spot! The survey list is 
filling up fast, and then...!"
choice_data_list: Yo!! Hup!! Hiii-yahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Investigation complete~~! Thanks to you, 
we finished quickly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the survey report to Tucker-san 
right away, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUUUUMBLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: !? Trainer, behind you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Trainer?! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
are you alright? How many fingers 
am I holding up?
choice_data_list: One stick... Where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You're in the first aid tent. You were 
knocked out by a wild deer and lost 
consciousness until just now.
choice_data_list: Just one... Where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It really gave me a fright. It doesn't 
seem like there are any serious injuries, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
His consciousness is clear,
but just to be 
safe, he should probably rest quietly for 
the day.
choice_data_list: I see... Sorry, Ines.
I see... I'm sorry, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I see... Sorry, Ines.
I see... I'm sorry, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Was *that* why you were being so 
unusually enthusiastic?"
choice_data_list: I wanted to let you get some rest,...
I wanted to let you rest, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you don't have to worry about it 
at all. Just knowing you feel that way 
makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, it's your turn next,
Trainer. Leave it 
to me and get some rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Here, coconut juice! Drink this and cheer 
up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Looks like there's some sweat on your 
forehead. I'll go get a towel to wipe it 
off~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you bored just lying beside me? 
Want to play the finger game I always
play 
with my little sisters?
choice_data_list: Um, having you look after me this ...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No holding back, no way! You've been 
pushing yourself way too hard today, you 
know?
choice_data_list: Um, having you take care of me thi...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Ines Fujin's reassuring smile, 
I vowed in my heart that next time, I 
would make sure she got to relax and 
refresh herself.
